_comment: type must be one of: exchange, mixer, instant_swap. 'instant_swap' is for no-KYC services like changenow.io/swapuz.io/fixedfloat.com that generate a one-time deposit address per swap - link_tracer.py will try to correlate a deposit into one of these with a plausible payout on the SAME entity's other wallets (see ENABLE_SWAP_CORRELATION in link_tracer.py). Add ONE entry per chain a service operates on, all sharing the exact same 'name' - that's how its wallets get grouped for correlation. 'chain' is optional (auto-detected from the address if omitted), but setting it explicitly avoids ambiguity.
name: Example Exchange Name

_comment: ChangeNOW's known BTC deposit/treasury wallet - REPLACE with an address you've actually confirmed belongs to them.
name: ChangeNOW

_comment: ChangeNOW's known ETH wallet, if you have one - same 'name' as above groups them together for correlation.
name: ChangeNOW

_comment: Bridge example - type "bridge" gets the SAME swap-correlation treatment as instant_swap (deposit on one chain, payout on another shortly after). Add one entry per chain the bridge operates on, all sharing the same name.
name: Example Bridge
